thought.text: Pertanyaan bagus. Saya cek dulu — apakah model obscurify yang kamu pakai mengirim `reasoning_content` atau tidak.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 400 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,subprocess
OB=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()
def ask(model,mt=300):
    b=json.dumps({"model":model,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Berapa 17*23? Jawab singkat."}],"max_tokens":mt}).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=b,
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=180) as x: return json.load(x)
for m in ["deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored",
          "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored:thinking",
          "qwen/qwen3.8-27b-uncensored",
          "qwen/qwen3.8-27b-uncensored:thinking",
          "z-ai/glm-5.3-uncensored"]:
    try:
        d=ask(m); msg=d['choices'][0]['message']; u=d['usage']
        print(f"{m:52}")
        print(f"   content  : {repr((msg.get('content') or '')[:70])}")
        print(f"   reasoning: {repr((msg.get('reasoning_content') or msg.get('reasoning') or '')[:70])}")
        print(f"   usage    : prompt={u['prompt_tokens']} compl={u['completion_tokens']} cost=${u['cost']:.6f}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: print(f"{m:52} HTTP{e.code} {e.read().decode()[:60]}")
PY
